hook.say: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet this morning: agents can pay, with a security check on every purchase. I went back in to check the numbers around it.

findings.label: COST
findings.headline: Cheapest way in: ChatGPT Pro, from $100 a month
findings.detail: Dots need Pro. Claude Duet is included in a $20 plan.
findings.evidence: ChatGPT Dots need Pro, which OpenAI prices from $100 a month
findings.say: First, getting in costs money. Dots need ChatGPT Pro, priced from $100 a month, against $20 for Anthropic's Claude Duet agent.

findings.label: BENCHMARK
findings.headline: Visa's shopper test: AI models failed 42.8% of the time
findings.detail: 22 models tested as shoppers. Agents in general, not Wallet itself.
findings.evidence: Visa tested 22 AI models acting as shoppers and found they failed 42.8% of the time.
findings.say: Second, Visa tested 22 AI models as shoppers and they failed 42.8% of the time. That is agents in general, not Wallet.

findings.label: PRECEDENT
findings.headline: Instant Checkout had about 30 Shopify merchants
findings.detail: Forrester's count, before OpenAI dropped it for its own checkout flow.
findings.evidence: As of last month, she said, roughly 30 Shopify merchants were available via Instant Checkout.
findings.say: Third, the predecessor, Instant Checkout, reached only about 30 Shopify merchants before OpenAI dropped it. Reach was the problem last time.

take.headline: Approval is easy. Reliability is not.
take.say: My take: approval is the easy part. Before giving an agent a card, measure how often it fails and how often it converts.

caption:
This morning I covered ChatGPT Wallet: AI agents can now pay, with a security check on every purchase.

Three new data points. Entry price is $100 a month for ChatGPT Pro, against $20 for Claude Duet. Visa's test of 22 AI models as shoppers found a 42.8% failure rate. The earlier Instant Checkout reached only about 30 Shopify merchants.

My take: approval is the easy part. Measure how often the agent fails and converts before you hand it a card.

Comment SDR and I will send you the details by DM.
